name: Toketsu
source:
"Toketsu..." "It's a Japanese word." "Some people think it means to freeze." "Or to be frozen." "Like a lake in the winter or a heart in the autumn." "But this is just a misspelling." "One I used too frequently." "In a story I wrote long ago..."

[From [url=https://www.renai.us/game/toketsu.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
“Toketsu……”
“这是个日语词。”
“有人以为它表示冻结。”
“或是被冻结。”
“像冬日的湖，又像秋日的心。”
“可它其实只是一个拼写错误。”
“一个被我用过太多次的错误。”
“就在我很久以前写下的故事里……”

[译自 [url=https://www.renai.us/game/toketsu.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
